test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The sides of a rectangle are 49 m and 35 m respectively. How many square beds can be accommodated in this rectangle if the side of the bed is 7 m ?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of rectangle = 49 m

Breadth of rectangle = 35 m

Side of square = 7 m

**Concept used:**

Area of square = Side × Side

Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculation:**

⇒ Area of rectangle = 49 × 35 = 1715 → (1)

⇒ Area of square = 7 × 7 = 49 → (2)

⇒ Number of square beds that can fit inside the rectangle = (Area of rectangle )/(Area of square bed)

⇒ Number of square beds from (1) & (2) = 1715over 49 = 35

**Therefore, 35 square beds can be accommodated in this rectangle.**
